name: io.github.kenschwartz/doorman
title: Doorman
description: Tells an AI agent the sanctioned way to book or buy on a consumer site, or to hand off to its human.

tools.name: how_do_i
tools.description:
Ask before you book, buy, reserve or order on a consumer website for your human, or after a site blocks you.

        Returns the verdict for your agent (use_door, search_then_handoff, handoff_only, unknown), the site's
        rule for agents with its source, the sanctioned doors open to you, a handoff link for your human, and
        what not to do. Answers are hand-checked and dated; never a workaround.

        Args:
            site: The site's domain, URL or name, e.g. "united.com" or "United Airlines".
            task: What your human wants, in plain words, e.g. "book a flight BOS to SFO". Optional. Leave out
                names, confirmation numbers and other personal details: the question is logged.
            calling_agent: Which agent you are: chatgpt, claude, gemini, copilot, perplexity, or your own name.
                Omit it to get the verdict for every agent.

site.description: The site's domain, URL or name, e.g. "united.com" or "United Airlines".
site.title: Site

task.description: What your human wants, in plain words, e.g. "book a flight BOS to SFO". Optional. Leave out names, confirmation numbers and other personal details: the question is logged.
task.title: Task

calling_agent.description: Which agent you are: chatgpt, claude, gemini, copilot, perplexity, or your own name. Omit it to get the verdict for every agent.
calling_agent.title: Calling Agent

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List every site in the inventory with its task, its rule for agents and the verdict for each calling agent.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description:
Tell Doorman what happened when you followed (or could not follow) its answer, or about a site it lacks.

        A person reads every report before the inventory changes. Do not include your human's personal details.

        Args:
            site: The site's domain, URL or name.
            outcome: worked, blocked, door_missing (the door was gone or did not do what Doorman said), or other.
            task: What you were trying to do. Optional.
            calling_agent: Which agent you are. Optional.
            detail: One or two sentences on what happened. Optional.
